core_claims: Same chiral setting plus current Gram, FESR and asymptotic FF constraints shrinks the upper boundary more than the lower.
One tip and two nearby upper-boundary amplitudes give the linked S0/S2/P1 curves.
QCD information supplies resonant P1 behavior absent in the selected chiral-only example.
S0/S2 curves largely coincide at low energy and spread high; P1 curves spread in the middle and agree more at both ends.

suggested_geometric_selection.status: Proposal for root to freeze before phase evaluation, not an author-specified algorithm.
suggested_geometric_selection.red: Full-space support maximizing x, with the same complete joint amplitude.
suggested_geometric_selection.light_pink: Upper boundary at x=xref; if reusing discrete E1 supports, closest upper-support x with error reported.
suggested_geometric_selection.pink: Upper boundary at x=(xref+x_tip)/2; reuse closest distinct upper-support x if appropriate.
suggested_geometric_selection.outside_case: If xref is outside the joint projected x interval, record the physical-point mismatch; do not silently replace xref.
suggested_geometric_selection.mixing: Prefer actual full-space support amplitudes; do not create the three phase curves by convex interpolation without explicitly reporting its additional inelasticity.
